copilot.title: Draft a workflow
copilot.hint: Describe what should happen. Review the draft on the canvas. Nothing turns on until you activate it.
copilot.greetingAsk: How can I help with sales and commerce today?
copilot.draftNote: This updates the canvas only. Nothing is saved until you save it.
copilot.salesNote: This runs on your distributor WhatsApp number. Agent replies are filed onto the open job. Buyer chats stay in customer service.
copilot.applied: The workflow structure is on the canvas. Save it when you are ready.

history.title: History
history.dockEmpty: Ask about this workflow, or about retailer prospects.
history.saveFailed: This reply is on screen, but the conversation was not saved.
history.deleteBody: This chat and its messages will be removed.

margins.label: Review margins
margins.title: Where margin moved
margins.summary: Compare revenue and cost this month, then list payments that are still open and worth chasing.
margins.prompt: Review this month's financials. Where did margin move, which payments are still open, and what should I chase first?

orders.label: Open orders
orders.title: Orders waiting on someone
orders.summary: Split open orders into paid, packing, and late, and say whether the next step is ours or the buyer's.
orders.prompt: Look at my open orders. Which are paid, packing, or late, and what should I follow up on today?

buyers.label: Quiet buyers
buyers.title: Buyers who went quiet
buyers.summary: Find shops that stopped ordering, and the ones whose recent orders say they are ready for another visit.
buyers.prompt: Analyze my buyers. Who has gone quiet, who is ordering more, and who should the sales team visit next?

products.label: Slow products
products.title: Products under pressure
products.summary: Find items under the stock line, under margin, or barely moving, and say what to fix first.
products.prompt: Review my products. Which are low on stock, weak on margin, or barely selling, and what should I fix first?

restock.label: Restock alert
restock.title: Replenish before a stockout
restock.summary: When a product crosses under its stock line, restock the quantity you set and notify the dashboard.
restock.prompt: When stock is low, replenish and notify me

winback.label: Win-back carts
winback.title: Bring back an idle cart
winback.summary: When a cart sits idle for a day, send a WhatsApp win-back. If they already ordered, the run stops.
winback.prompt: When a cart sits idle, send a win-back on WhatsApp

copilot.unknown: I could not answer that just now. Try again, or ask about orders, buyers, products, sales, or an automation.
copilot.featureUnavailable: Workflow feature is not available, try another thing.

low_stock.prompt: When stock is low, replenish and notify me
low_stock.name: Replenish low stock
low_stock.summary: When a product falls under its stock line, restock it and notify the dashboard.
low_stock.logic: If stock is still above the line, the run stops. If it crossed under, replenish the quantity you set, then notify the dashboard. Pick the product on the canvas before you turn this on.

buyer_question.prompt: When a buyer asks on WhatsApp, stay in customer service
buyer_question.name: Buyer WhatsApp service
buyer_question.summary: When a buyer messages your WhatsApp number, stay in the 24 hour service window.
buyer_question.logic: Answer catalog and order questions in that window. If they ask for a person, hand the chat off. Otherwise stop the run after the reply.

return_accepted.prompt: When a return is accepted, confirm it on WhatsApp
return_accepted.name: Confirm an accepted return
return_accepted.summary: When a return is accepted, confirm it to the buyer and notify the dashboard.
return_accepted.logic: Send the confirmation on WhatsApp, then notify the dashboard. Add the buyer and connect WhatsApp on the canvas before you turn this on.
return_accepted.template: Your return was accepted. We will confirm the next step.

new_buyer.prompt: When a new buyer is created, assign a sales agent
new_buyer.name: Assign a new buyer
new_buyer.summary: When a buyer places a first order, tell the sales team and notify the dashboard.
new_buyer.logic: Message the team on WhatsApp to assign an agent, then notify the dashboard. If nobody is available, stop and leave the notice on the dashboard.
new_buyer.template: A new buyer placed a first order. Assign a sales agent.

order_paid.prompt: When payment proof is submitted, mark the order paid
order_paid.name: Mark paid from proof
order_paid.summary: When a buyer submits payment proof, mark the order paid and notify the dashboard.
order_paid.logic: Only a submitted proof starts this. Mark the order paid from that proof, then notify the dashboard. If there is no proof, the run does not start.

cart_idle.prompt: When a cart sits idle, send a win-back on WhatsApp
cart_idle.name: Win back an idle cart
cart_idle.summary: When a cart sits idle for 24 hours, send a win-back on WhatsApp.
cart_idle.logic: Wait 24 hours. If the cart is still idle, send the win-back. If they already ordered, stop. Connect WhatsApp and pick the buyer on the canvas before you turn this on.
cart_idle.template: You left items in your cart. Reply if you still want them.

sales_job_assign.prompt: When a sales job is created, assign it and message the salesman on WhatsApp
sales_job_assign.name: Assign a sales job
sales_job_assign.summary: When a sales job is created, Lakupak AI assigns it to the salesman and sends the WhatsApp message.
sales_job_assign.logic: Start when the job is created. Lakupak AI connects through WhatsApp, then Assign sales job sends the message to that salesman.
sales_job_assign.template: New job for {store}: {job}. {reason} Reply in this chat when the visit is done.

sales_jobs.prompt: Remind sales agents and file their WhatsApp replies on the job
sales_jobs.name: Sales job replies
sales_jobs.summary: Your distributor WhatsApp number sends job assignments to sales agents and can also serve buyers.
sales_jobs.logic: When an agent replies in ordinary language, the visit is matched to their open job. If several shops are open, they are asked which shop. If a required fact is missing, they are asked on WhatsApp. Clear facts are saved on the job. You can still correct them on the job page.

triggerHints.return_accepted: Fires when a return is received and stock can be restored
triggerHints.cart_idle: Fires when a marketplace cart stays idle for X hours
triggerHints.sales_job_created: Fires when a sales job is created

actionHints.replenish_stock: Write replenish quantity into stock when the workflow is active
actionHints.whatsapp_buyer: Send a message to selected buyers through WhatsApp, Email, or both. Use for stock, orders, CS, or other operational updates.
actionHints.share_product_whatsapp: Share a selected product with buyers on WhatsApp, Email, or both
actionHints.draft_activate_offer: Draft or activate a clearance offer for a set window
actionHints.assign_agent_whatsapp: Assign a sales rep for same-chat handoff after the buyer shares their territory
actionHints.buyer_question_reply: Reply with pre-authored messages; escalate out-of-scope to an agent

actionHints.assign_logistic: Auto-assign logistics using a fleet from your account
actionHints.assign_driver: Auto-assign the driver linked to a selected fleet
actionHints.assign_fleet: Match fleet by capacity, area, or load and push the driver
actionHints.return_confirm_whatsapp: Confirm stock restore and notify the buyer on WhatsApp, Email, or both
actionHints.mark_paid_from_proof: Set the order payment status to Paid when payment proof is on file
actionHints.cart_winback: Send a cart win-back with optional offer on WhatsApp, Email, or both
actionHints.assign_sales_job: Assign the new sales job to its salesman and send the WhatsApp message
actionHints.notify_dashboard: Posts the live run result (e.g. replenish details) as a dashboard notification, no template needed.
